"""Generate/check schema types only from the owned MP-05.a fixture; no remote inputs."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("bootstrap", ROOT / "scripts/test-db-bootstrap.py")
h = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(h)
META_IMAGE = "public.ecr.aws/supabase/postgres-meta:v0.98.0"
DESTINATION = ROOT / "src/lib/types/database.ts"
EVIDENCE = ROOT / "docs/state/evidence"
INVENTORY_SQL = ROOT / "tests/integration/db/schema-inventory.sql"


def generate_one(db_id, workdir, password, report, image_id, cycle):
    name = report["project_id"] + f"-types-{cycle}"
    cidfile = workdir / f"types-{cycle}.id"
    env = {"PG_META_DB_URL": f"postgresql://postgres:{password}@127.0.0.1:5432/postgres?sslmode=disable",
           "PG_CONN_TIMEOUT_SECS": "15", "PG_QUERY_TIMEOUT_SECS": "15", "PG_META_GENERATE_TYPES": "typescript",
           "PG_META_GENERATE_TYPES_INCLUDED_SCHEMAS": "public",
           "PG_META_GENERATE_TYPES_DETECT_ONE_TO_ONE_RELATIONSHIPS": "true"}
    try:
        h.run(h.DOCKER + ["create", "--name", name, "--label", f"{h.LABEL}.types={name}",
              "--cidfile", str(cidfile), "--network", f"container:{db_id}",
              *[arg for key in env for arg in ("-e", key)], image_id, "node", "dist/server/server.js"],
              cwd=workdir, timeout=30, extra_env=env)
        cid = cidfile.read_text().strip()
        info = h.inspect_container(cid, workdir)
        if (not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", cid) or info["id"] != cid or info["name"] != "/" + name
                or info["image"] != image_id or info["labels"].get(h.LABEL + ".types") != name
                or info["network"] != f"container:{db_id}" or info["bindings"] or info["mounts"]):
            h.fail("generator container identity/isolation differs from owned plan")
        result = subprocess.run(h.DOCKER + ["start", "-a", cid], cwd=workdir, env=h.LOCAL_ENV,
                                text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", capture_output=True, timeout=60)
        if result.returncode:
            h.fail("type generator failed: " + h.safe_error((result.stderr + result.stdout).replace(password, "[redacted]")))
        generated = result.stdout.replace("\r\n", "\n").strip() + "\n"
        if (not generated.startswith("export type Json =") or "export type Database =" not in generated
                or re.search(r"\bany\b|PLACEHOLDER|Record<string,", generated) or password in generated):
            h.fail("type generator did not emit a valid non-placeholder TypeScript artifact")
        return generated
    finally:
        try:
            if not h.owned(workdir, report["project_id"]):
                h.fail("generator cleanup workdir ownership differs")
            ids = h.docker(["ps", "-aq", "--no-trunc", "--filter", f"label={h.LABEL}.types={name}"], cwd=workdir, timeout=20).split()
            captured = cidfile.read_text().strip() if cidfile.is_file() else ""
            if (ids or captured) and (not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", captured) or ids != [captured]):
                h.fail("generator cleanup requires matching captured ID; resources retained")
            for cid in ids:
                info = h.inspect_container(cid, workdir)
                if info["id"] != cid or info["name"] != "/" + name or info["image"] != image_id or info["labels"].get(h.LABEL + ".types") != name:
                    h.fail("generator cleanup ownership differs; resources retained")
                h.docker(["rm", "-f", "-v", cid], cwd=workdir, timeout=30)
            if h.docker(["ps", "-aq", "--filter", f"label={h.LABEL}.types={name}"], cwd=workdir, timeout=20).strip():
                h.fail("generator remains after cleanup")
        except (RuntimeError, OSError, ValueError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
            # The parent must not erase generator ownership evidence on cleanup failure.
            (workdir / "retain-resources").write_text("generator cleanup needs inspection\n")
            raise


def finish_artifact(text, mode):
    if mode == "--check":
        if DESTINATION.read_bytes() != text.encode("utf-8"):
            h.fail("checked-in database types differ from the regenerated schema; run db:types")
    else:
        temporary = DESTINATION.with_suffix(".ts.pending")
        with temporary.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as output:
            output.write(text)
        temporary.replace(DESTINATION)


def main(*, evidence_prefix="MP-05b"):
    if not re.fullmatch(r"MP-\d{2}[a-z](?:[1-9]\d*)?", evidence_prefix):
        h.fail("invalid internal evidence prefix")
    if sys.argv[1:] not in (["--write"], ["--check"]):
        h.fail("choose --write or --check; external URLs/project refs are not accepted")
    mode = sys.argv[1]
    report = {"status": "failed", "mode": mode, "scope": "public schema types and catalog only; no auth/RLS acceptance"}
    original_hash = hashlib.sha256(DESTINATION.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    try:
        h.require_local_docker(ROOT)
        image_id = h.docker(["image", "inspect", "--format", "{{.Id}}", META_IMAGE], cwd=ROOT, timeout=20).strip()
        outputs, inventories = [], []

        def after_reset(db_id, workdir, password, fixture_report):
            outputs.append(generate_one(db_id, workdir, password, fixture_report, image_id, len(outputs) + 1))
            inventories.append(json.loads(h.psql(db_id, workdir, INVENTORY_SQL.read_text())))

        h.REPORT = EVIDENCE / f"{evidence_prefix}-types-bootstrap.json"
        argv = sys.argv
        try:
            sys.argv = [argv[0]]
            if h.main(after_reset=after_reset) != 0:
                h.fail("type generation fixture failed; see sanitized bootstrap evidence")
        finally:
            sys.argv = argv
        if len(outputs) != 2 or outputs[0] != outputs[1] or inventories[0] != inventories[1]:
            h.fail("types or schema/grants inventory differ across the two real resets")
        (EVIDENCE / f"{evidence_prefix}-schema-inventory.json").write_text(json.dumps(inventories[0], indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        finish_artifact(outputs[0], mode)
        report.update(status="passed", generations=2, outputs_equal=True, inventory_equal=True,
                      generator_image=META_IMAGE, generator_image_id=image_id,
                      types_sha256=hashlib.sha256(outputs[0].encode()).hexdigest(),
                      generator_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                      fixture_sha256=hashlib.sha256((ROOT / "scripts/test-db-bootstrap.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest())
    except (RuntimeError, OSError, ValueError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
        report["error"] = str(error) if isinstance(error, RuntimeError) else type(error).__name__
    finally:
        report["artifact_unchanged"] = hashlib.sha256(DESTINATION.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == original_hash
        (EVIDENCE / f"{evidence_prefix}-types-{mode[2:]}.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(report))
    return 0 if report["status"] == "passed" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import secrets
import shutil
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import tomllib
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SUPABASE = ROOT / "node_modules/.pnpm/@supabase+cli-windows-x64@2.116.0/node_modules/@supabase/cli-windows-x64/bin/supabase.exe"
MIGRATIONS = ROOT / "supabase/migrations"
ASSERTIONS = ROOT / "tests/integration/db/bootstrap.sql"
PREFIX = ".hcb-bootstrap-"
DOCKER = ["docker", "--context", "default"]
LOCAL_ENV = {key: value for key, value in __import__("os").environ.items() if key.upper() in {"PATH", "SYSTEMROOT", "WINDIR", "TEMP", "TMP", "USERPROFILE", "LOCALAPPDATA", "APPDATA", "COMSPEC", "PATHEXT"}}
LOCAL_ENV["DOCKER_HOST"] = "npipe:////./pipe/docker_engine"
REPORT = ROOT / "docs/state/evidence/MP-05a-bootstrap.json"
IMAGE = "public.ecr.aws/supabase/postgres:15.8.1.085"
LABEL = "io.happy-cookie.bootstrap"


def fail(message: str) -> None:
    raise RuntimeError(message)

def safe_error(output: str) -> str:
    """Return only recognisable diagnostics; never persist raw CLI output."""
    lines = [re.sub(r'^psql:.*?:\s*(?=ERROR:|FATAL:)', '', line) for line in output.splitlines()]
    selected = [line.strip() for line in lines
                if re.match(r"\s*(?:ERROR:|FATAL:|Applying migration |failed to |error during connect)", line, re.I)]
    text = " ".join(selected[-4:]) or "raw command output suppressed"
    text = re.sub(r"(?:postgres(?:ql)?|https?)://\S+", "[redacted-url]", text, flags=re.I)
    text = re.sub(r"(?i)(password|token|jwt|apikey|api[_-]?key)\s*[=:]\s*\S+", r"\1=[redacted]", text)
    text = re.sub(r"eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+|sb_(?:secret|publishable)_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+", "[redacted-key]", text)
    text = re.sub(r"'[^']*'", "'[redacted-literal]'", text)
    return text[:1200]

def run(args: list[str], *, cwd: Path, timeout: int, input_text: str | None = None,
        extra_env: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> str:
    with subprocess.Popen(args, cwd=cwd, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace",
                          stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=LOCAL_ENV | (extra_env or {})) as child:
        try:
            output, _ = child.communicate(input_text, timeout=timeout)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            try:
                subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/PID", str(child.pid), "/T", "/F"], capture_output=True, timeout=10)
            finally:
                child.kill()
            child.communicate(timeout=10)
            fail(f"command exceeded {timeout}-second deadline; owned process terminated")
        if child.returncode:
            for value in (extra_env or {}).values():
                if value:
                    output = output.replace(value, "[redacted-generated-secret]")
            fail(f"command exit {child.returncode}: {safe_error(output)}")
        return output

def docker(args: list[str], *, cwd: Path, timeout: int, input_text: str | None = None) -> str:
    return run(DOCKER + args, cwd=cwd, timeout=timeout, input_text=input_text)

def require_local_docker(workdir: Path) -> None:
    host = docker(["context", "inspect", "default", "--format", "{{.Endpoints.docker.Host}}"], cwd=workdir, timeout=30).strip().lower()
    if host != LOCAL_ENV["DOCKER_HOST"]:
        fail("Docker default context does not match the pinned Windows local endpoint")
    docker(["version", "--format", "{{.Server.Version}}"], cwd=workdir, timeout=20)

def local_ports() -> tuple[int, int, int]:
    for base in range(45000 + secrets.randbelow(4000), 49000):
        ports = (base, base + 1, base + 2)
        probes: list[socket.socket] = []
        try:
            for port in ports:
                probe = socket.socket()
                probes.append(probe)
                probe.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
            return ports
        except OSError:
            pass
        finally:
            for probe in probes:
                probe.close()
    fail("no free consecutive loopback ports for disposable Supabase project")

def expected_versions() -> list[str]:
    versions = []
    for path in sorted(MIGRATIONS.glob("[0-9]*_*.sql")):
        match = re.match(r"(\d+)_", path.name)
        if match:
            versions.append(match.group(1))
    expected = [str(20260101000000 + 100 * index) for index in range(23)]
    if versions != expected:
        fail("source migrations differ from the eight baseline versions plus MP-06.a")
    return versions

def copy_project(workdir: Path, project_id: str, ports: tuple[int, int, int]) -> None:
    destination = workdir / "supabase"
    shutil.copytree(MIGRATIONS, destination / "migrations")
    config = (ROOT / "supabase/config.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    parsed = tomllib.loads(config)
    if parsed.get("auth", {}).get("site_url") != "http://localhost:3000" or parsed.get("auth", {}).get("additional_redirect_urls") != ["http://localhost:3000"]:
        fail("source config auth URLs differ from the reviewed local-only URLs")
    remaining = config.replace("http://localhost:3000", "")
    if re.search(r"project_ref|https?://|postgres(?:ql)?://|env\(", remaining, re.I):
        fail("source config contains unreviewed external/environment references")
    config = re.sub(r'(?m)^project_id\s*=\s*"[^"]+"', f'project_id = "{project_id}"', config, count=1)
    for section, port in zip(("api", "db", "studio"), ports):
        pattern = rf"(?ms)(^\[{section}\]\s*.*?^port\s*=\s*)\d+"
        config, count = re.subn(pattern, rf"\g<1>{port}", config, count=1)
        if count != 1:
            fail(f"temporary config lacks one [{section}] port")
    (destination / "config.toml").write_text(config.rstrip() + "\n\n[db.seed]\nenabled = false\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (workdir / "owner.json").write_text(json.dumps({"project_id": project_id}), encoding="utf-8")
    if (destination / ".temp").exists() or (destination / "seed.sql").exists():
        fail("temporary project inherited a project link or seed fixture")

def owned(workdir: Path, project_id: str) -> bool:
    try:
        return (workdir.resolve() == workdir and workdir.parent == ROOT.parent.resolve()
                and not workdir.is_symlink() and not workdir.is_junction()
                and workdir.name == PREFIX + project_id.removeprefix("hcb-")
                and re.fullmatch(r"hcb-[a-f0-9]+-[a-f0-9]{6}", project_id) is not None
                and json.loads((workdir / "owner.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["project_id"] == project_id)
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError):
        return False

def inspect_container(container_id: str, workdir: Path) -> dict:
    # Select metadata only: full inspect includes the generated password in Config.Env.
    fields = {"id": ".Id", "name": ".Name", "image": ".Image", "labels": ".Config.Labels",
              "bindings": ".HostConfig.PortBindings", "ports": ".NetworkSettings.Ports",
              "network": ".HostConfig.NetworkMode", "running": ".State.Running", "mounts": ".Mounts"}
    template = "{" + ",".join('"' + k + '":{{json ' + v + '}}' for k, v in fields.items()) + "}"
    return json.loads(docker(["inspect", "--format", template, container_id], cwd=workdir, timeout=20))


def assert_identity(info: dict, container_id: str, project_id: str, image_id: str) -> None:
    if (not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", container_id) or info["id"] != container_id
            or info["name"] != "/" + project_id or info["image"] != image_id
            or (info["labels"] or {}).get(LABEL) != project_id
            or any(mount["Type"] != "volume" for mount in info["mounts"])):
        fail("container identity, ownership, image or mount contract differs")


def assert_loopback(info: dict, port: int, *, running: bool = True) -> None:
    expected = {"5432/tcp": [{"HostIp": "127.0.0.1", "HostPort": str(port)}]}
    if (info["bindings"] != expected or info["network"] != "bridge"
            or (running and (not info["running"] or info["ports"] != expected))):
        fail("disposable database does not have the exact loopback-only port binding")


def sql_for(versions: list[str]) -> str:
    values = ", ".join("'" + version + "'" for version in versions)
    template = ASSERTIONS.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    if template.count("__EXPECTED_MIGRATIONS__") != 2:
        fail("bootstrap SQL expected-migration marker is invalid")
    return template.replace("__EXPECTED_MIGRATIONS__", values)


def psql(container_id: str, workdir: Path, sql: str) -> str:
    return docker(["exec", "-i", container_id, "psql", "-X", "-q", "-v", "ON_ERROR_STOP=1", "-U", "postgres", "-d", "postgres", "-A", "-t", "-F", "\t"], cwd=workdir, timeout=60, input_text=sql)


def normalize_schema_dump(schema: str) -> str:
    """Canonicalize only adjacent plain table grants for one identical object."""
    schema = re.sub(r"(?m)^\\(?:un)?restrict .*\n?", "", schema)
    lines = schema.splitlines(keepends=True)
    output, block, target = [], [], None
    pattern = re.compile(r'^GRANT [A-Z, ]+ ON TABLE (public\.[a-z_]+) TO [a-z_]+;\n?$')
    for line in lines:
        match = pattern.fullmatch(line)
        current = match.group(1) if match else None
        if current is None or current != target:
            output.extend(sorted(block))
            block = []
        if current is None:
            output.append(line)
        else:
            block.append(line)
        target = current
    output.extend(sorted(block))
    return ''.join(output)


def catalog(container_id: str, workdir: Path, sql: str) -> str:
    output = psql(container_id, workdir, sql)
    lines = sorted(line for line in output.splitlines() if line.strip())
    if not lines or any(line.count("\t") != 2 for line in lines):
        fail("catalog assertion emitted an invalid inventory")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def cleanup(workdir: Path, project_id: str, image_id: str) -> None:
    if not owned(workdir, project_id):
        fail("refusing cleanup of a non-owned project target")
    if (workdir / "retain-resources").exists():
        fail("dependent fixture cleanup failed; retain owned resources for inspection")
    ids = docker(["ps", "-aq", "--no-trunc", "--filter", f"label={LABEL}={project_id}"], cwd=workdir, timeout=20).split()
    if len(ids) > 1:
        fail("multiple containers claim this run; retain workdir for inspection")
    cid_path = workdir / "container.id"
    captured = cid_path.read_text().strip() if cid_path.is_file() else ""
    if ((ids or captured) and (not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{64}", captured) or ids != [captured])):
        fail("cleanup requires the captured creation ID and exactly one matching owned container")
    for container_id in ids:
        assert_identity(inspect_container(container_id, workdir), container_id, project_id, image_id)
        docker(["rm", "-f", "-v", container_id], cwd=workdir, timeout=30)
    if docker(["ps", "-aq", "--filter", f"label={LABEL}={project_id}"], cwd=workdir, timeout=20).strip():
        fail("owned container remains after cleanup")
    shutil.rmtree(workdir)


def main(*, fail_after_start: bool = False, after_reset=None) -> int:
    if len(sys.argv) != 1:
        fail("this harness accepts no URLs, project refs, or other arguments")
    if not SUPABASE.is_file() or not ASSERTIONS.is_file():
        fail("pinned Supabase CLI or bootstrap SQL is missing")
    token = f"{int(time.time()):x}-{secrets.token_hex(3)}"
    project_id = f"hcb-{token}"
    workdir = ROOT.parent / f"{PREFIX}{token}"
    created = False
    image_id = ""
    report = {"status": "failed", "scope": "explicit-connection CLI reset on disposable loopback PostgreSQL; not managed --local or auth/RLS acceptance",
              "project_id": project_id, "workdir": str(workdir), "cleanup": "pending", "resets": 0,
              "harness_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "assertions_sha256": hashlib.sha256(ASSERTIONS.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "binding_checks": [],
              "source_hashes": {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(MIGRATIONS.glob("*.sql"))}}
    try:
        workdir.mkdir()
        created = True
        (workdir / "owner.json").write_text(json.dumps({"project_id": project_id}), encoding="utf-8")
        require_local_docker(workdir)
        ports = local_ports()
        copy_project(workdir, project_id, ports)
        port = ports[0]  # Intentionally distinct from temporary config db.port (ports[1]).
        config = tomllib.loads((workdir / "supabase/config.toml").read_text())
        if port in {config["db"]["port"], config["db"].get("shadow_port", 54320)}:
            fail("explicit target would select CLI managed-local recreation")
        sql = sql_for(expected_versions())
        image_id = docker(["image", "inspect", "--format", "{{.Id}}", IMAGE], cwd=workdir, timeout=20).strip()
        password = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
        run(DOCKER + ["create", "--name", project_id, "--label", f"{LABEL}={project_id}",
            "--cidfile", str(workdir / "container.id"), "--network", "bridge", "-p", f"127.0.0.1:{port}:5432",
            "-e", "POSTGRES_PASSWORD", image_id], cwd=workdir, timeout=30, extra_env={"POSTGRES_PASSWORD": password})
        container_id = (workdir / "container.id").read_text().strip()

        def check_binding(running: bool = True) -> None:
            info = inspect_container(container_id, workdir)
            assert_identity(info, container_id, project_id, image_id)
            assert_loopback(info, port, running=running)
            report["binding_checks"].append({"running_required": running, "bindings": info["ports"] if running else info["bindings"]})

        check_binding(False)
        docker(["start", container_id], cwd=workdir, timeout=30)
        check_binding()
        if fail_after_start:
            fail("injected failure after owned container startup")
        for attempt in range(45):
            try:
                docker(["exec", container_id, "pg_isready", "-h", "127.0.0.1", "-U", "postgres"], cwd=workdir, timeout=5)
                break
            except RuntimeError:
                time.sleep(1)
        else:
            fail("disposable PostgreSQL did not become ready")
        version = psql(container_id, workdir, "show server_version_num;").strip()
        if not version.isdigit() or int(version) // 10000 != 15:
            fail("disposable server is not PostgreSQL 15")
        cli_version = run([str(SUPABASE), "--version"], cwd=workdir, timeout=20).splitlines()[0]
        if cli_version != "2.116.0":
            fail("installed Supabase CLI differs from the reviewed pinned version")
        report.update(database_image=image_id, postgres_version_num=version, cli_version=cli_version,
                      loopback_port=port, container_id=container_id)
        inventories, schemas = [], []
        target = f"postgresql://postgres@127.0.0.1:{port}/postgres?sslmode=disable&connect_timeout=5"
        for cycle in range(2):
            check_binding()
            print(f"Running explicit loopback CLI reset {cycle + 1} and catalog assertions.", flush=True)
            run([str(SUPABASE), "db", "reset", "--workdir", str(workdir), "--yes", "--no-seed", "--db-url", target],
                cwd=workdir, timeout=120, extra_env={"PGPASSWORD": password})
            check_binding()
            inventories.append(catalog(container_id, workdir, sql))
            if psql(container_id, workdir, "select to_regclass('public.mp05_reset_sentinel') is null;").strip() != "t":
                fail("reset did not remove the disposable sentinel table")
            schema = docker(["exec", container_id, "pg_dump", "-U", "postgres", "-d", "postgres", "--schema-only", "--schema=public"], cwd=workdir, timeout=30)
            schemas.append(normalize_schema_dump(schema))
            if after_reset is not None:
                after_reset(container_id, workdir, password, report)
                check_binding()
            report["resets"] = cycle + 1
            if cycle == 0:
                psql(container_id, workdir, "create table public.mp05_reset_sentinel (id integer); insert into public.mp05_reset_sentinel values (1);")
        if inventories[0] != inventories[1] or schemas[0] != schemas[1]:
            # Preserve exact schema-only evidence; do not normalize away real drift.
            import difflib
            report['reset_catalog_diff'] = list(difflib.unified_diff(
                inventories[0].splitlines(), inventories[1].splitlines(), lineterm=''))
            report['reset_schema_diff'] = list(difflib.unified_diff(
                schemas[0].splitlines(), schemas[1].splitlines(), lineterm=''))
            fail("catalog or public schema differs across two explicit loopback resets")
        report.update(status="passed", expected_versions=expected_versions(), catalog=inventories[0].splitlines(),
                      catalog_sha256=hashlib.sha256(inventories[0].encode()).hexdigest(), catalogs_equal=True,
                      schema_sha256=hashlib.sha256(schemas[0].encode()).hexdigest(), schemas_equal=True, sentinel_removed=True)
    except (RuntimeError, OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
        report["error"] = str(error) if isinstance(error, RuntimeError) else type(error).__name__
    finally:
        if created:
            try:
                cleanup(workdir, project_id, image_id)
                report["cleanup"] = "passed"
            except (RuntimeError, OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
                report.update(status="failed", cleanup="failed; owned workdir retained", cleanup_error=type(error).__name__)
        REPORT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({key: report.get(key) for key in ("status", "error", "cleanup")}))

--
-- This must agree with src/lib/rules/capacity.ts exactly, forever. The parity test in
-- tests/unit/capacity-parity.test.ts runs both over the same table of cases and fails CI
-- if they diverge. If you change one, change the other in the same commit — that is the

/**
 * The same decision as decideCapacity() in TypeScript. Kept as its own function so the
 * parity test has something to call, rather than asserting against an inlined expression
 * buried in the order insert.
 */

  p_capacity  integer,
  p_committed integer,
  p_requested integer
)
returns boolean
language sql
immutable
as $$
  select p_requested > 0
     and p_requested <= greatest(0, greatest(0, floor(p_capacity)::integer)
                                    - greatest(0, floor(p_committed)::integer));
$$;

-- Retention and erasure.
--
-- Under the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173, Chapter IV, and IRR §34) a customer has a
-- right to erasure or blocking of their personal data, exercisable at no cost. The owner
-- is the personal information controller.
--
-- The important nuance, and the reason this is not a DELETE:
--
--   Erasure removes the data. Blocking restricts it to a purpose that another law
--   requires. BIR record-keeping means a completed sale cannot simply be deleted — the
--   financial record must survive an audit. So the correct response to an erasure request
--   on a paid order is to BLOCK: strip the personal information, keep the money.
--
-- That is what anonymise_customer() does. The order, its items and its ledger entries
-- stay intact and auditable; the name, phone and notes do not.

-- digest() for the request log. First, not last: a plpgsql body is not resolved at
-- creation time, so creating the extension afterwards happens to work and is luck.
create extension if not exists pgcrypto;

-- Who asked, when, and what was done. The NPC expects a controller to be able to show
-- this, and the owner should not have to remember.
create table if not exists erasure_requests (
  id           uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  phone_hash   text not null,               -- never the number itself
  requested_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  actioned_at  timestamptz,
  action       text check (action in ('anonymised', 'deleted', 'refused')),
  -- Why, in the owner's words. Refusals need a reason on the record.
  note         text not null default '',
  orders_affected integer not null default 0
);

alter table erasure_requests enable row level security;
create policy "erasure requests owner only" on erasure_requests
  for all using (is_owner()) with check (is_owner());

/**
 * Blocks a customer's personal data while preserving the financial record.
 *
 * Replaces the name with 'Removed on request', clears the phone and notes, and records
 * what happened. Returns the number of orders affected so the owner can confirm it
 * matched who she meant.
 *
 * Orders that are still live (not yet collected or paid) are DELETED rather than
 * anonymised — there is no tax record to preserve for a box nobody has bought, and an
 * anonymous pending order is just a box nobody can collect.
 */
create or replace function anonymise_customer(p_phone text, p_note text default '')
returns integer
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_norm    text;
  v_blocked integer := 0;
  v_removed integer := 0;
begin
  if not is_owner() then
    raise exception 'only the owner may action an erasure request';
  end if;

  -- Must match normalisePhone() in src/lib/idempotency.ts and lookup_order().
  v_norm := regexp_replace(p_phone, '\D', '', 'g');
  if left(v_norm, 2) = '63' then v_norm := '0' || substr(v_norm, 3); end if;

  -- Live orders: nothing to preserve, remove them.
  with removed as (
    delete from orders
    where regexp_replace(phone, '\D', '', 'g') = v_norm
      -- 'Payment review' is where an order sits before proof of payment arrives. Nothing
      -- has been paid and no tax record exists, so there is nothing to preserve.
      and state = 'Payment review'
      and pay_state = 'unpaid'
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*) into v_removed from removed;

  -- Everything else is a financial record. Block, do not erase.
  with blocked as (
    update orders
       set customer_name = 'Removed on request',
           phone = '',
           notes = ''
     where regexp_replace(phone, '\D', '', 'g') = v_norm
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*) into v_blocked from blocked;

  insert into erasure_requests (phone_hash, actioned_at, action, note, orders_affected)
  values (encode(digest(v_norm, 'sha256'), 'hex'), now(), 'anonymised', p_note, v_blocked + v_removed);

  return v_blocked + v_removed;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Deletes personal data from orders older than the retention period, keeping the money.
 *
 * The engine already carries RETENTION_DAYS and nothing enforced it. This does. Run it
 * from a monthly cron: a customer's phone number has no purpose two years after they
 * collected their cookies, and data you no longer hold cannot leak.
 */
create or replace function prune_personal_data(p_retain_days integer default 730)
returns integer
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
declare
  v_count integer;
begin
  with pruned as (
    update orders
       set customer_name = 'Past customer',
           phone = '',
           notes = ''
     where placed_at < now() - make_interval(days => p_retain_days)
       and phone <> ''
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*) into v_count from pruned;
  return v_count;
end;
$$;

comment on function prune_personal_data(integer) is
  'Enforces RETENTION_DAYS. Anonymises orders past the window; the financial record survives for BIR.';

-- Optimistic concurrency on the tables two people can edit at once.
--
-- Two users is not a distributed system, and it does not need versioning, vector clocks
-- or a merge policy. It needs one thing: a write must fail rather than silently overwrite
-- an edit made since it was read. Last-write-wins is fine for a note; it is not fine when
-- the owner marks an order paid and a helper's stale form marks it unpaid a second later.
--
-- The rule: every update sends the updated_at it read. If the row has moved on, the
-- update affects zero rows and the caller gets a 409 telling it to re-read.

create or replace function touch_updated_at()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
as $$
begin
  new.updated_at := now();
  return new;
end;
$$;

do $$
declare
  t text;
begin
  foreach t in array array['orders', 'order_items', 'inventory_items', 'bake_batches', 'drops']
  loop
    execute format('alter table %I add column if not exists updated_at timestamptz not null default now()', t);
    execute format('drop trigger if exists %I_touch on %I', t, t);
    execute format(
      'create trigger %I_touch before update on %I for each row execute function touch_updated_at()',
      t, t
    );
  end loop;
end;
$$;

/**
 * Guarded update of an order's state.
 *
 * p_seen_at is the updated_at the caller read. If the row has changed since, this returns
 * no row and the handler answers 409 — which is the honest answer, because the caller's
 * decision was made against data that no longer holds.
 *
 * Returning the current row on conflict would be friendlier and wrong: it invites the
 * caller to retry blindly with the same stale decision.
 */
create or replace function update_order_state(
  p_order_id  text,
  p_seen_at   timestamptz,
  p_state     text default null,
  p_pay_state text default null,
  p_pay_ref   text default null
)
returns table (id text, state text, pay_state text, updated_at timestamptz)
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  if not is_staff() then
    raise exception 'only staff may change an order';
  end if;

  return query
    update orders o
       set state     = coalesce(p_state, o.state),
           pay_state = coalesce(p_pay_state, o.pay_state),
           pay_ref   = coalesce(p_pay_ref, o.pay_ref)
     where o.id = p_order_id
       -- The guard. Millisecond equality is exact here: updated_at is set by the trigger,
       -- never by a client, so the value the caller read is the value in the row.
       and o.updated_at = p_seen_at
    returning o.id, o.state, o.pay_state, o.updated_at;
end;
$$;

comment on function update_order_state(text, timestamptz, text, text, text) is
  'Optimistic concurrency: returns no row if the order changed since p_seen_at. The handler must answer 409, not retry.';

-- Owner-editable settings.
--
-- The engine carries 21 of these in DEFAULT_CFG and the Settings screen edits them. There
-- was nowhere to store any of it. That is fine while the books live in localStorage, and
-- becomes a real loss the moment T-14 removes it: every setting she has ever changed
-- reverts to a default on a new device, silently, including her capacity and her prices.
--
-- One row, keyed by name, rather than one wide row. The engine's config is a flat bag of
-- scalars that grows, and a wide table needs a migration for each new key while an agent
-- is mid-task. The typed columns keep it honest — a value cannot be stored as the wrong
-- kind, which a jsonb blob would happily allow.
--
-- Money is centavos, consistent with everything else. packagingFee 38.44 is stored 3844.

create table if not exists settings (
  key         text primary key,
  int_value   bigint,
  text_value  text,
  -- Centavos. Separate from int_value so a peso value can never be read as a count.
  cents_value bigint,
  updated_at  timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_by  uuid references auth.users,

  -- Exactly one value column may be set. Without this, a key can hold two different
  -- answers and the reader picks whichever it looked at first.
  constraint settings_one_value check (
    (int_value is not null)::int + (text_value is not null)::int + (cents_value is not null)::int <= 1
  )
);

comment on table settings is
  'Mirrors the engine''s DEFAULT_CFG. Read through settings_effective(); it falls back to the engine defaults for any key the owner has never touched.';

returns trigger language plpgsql as $$
begin

  new.updated_by := auth.uid();

end;
$$;

import copy

import runpy
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
guard = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / 'scripts/verify-function-authority.py'))
BASE = json.loads(guard['MANIFEST'].read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['functions']


class FunctionAuthority(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exact_inventory_and_reordering_pass(self):
        self.assertEqual(guard['verify_functions'](BASE), 17)
        self.assertEqual(guard['verify_functions'](list(reversed(BASE))), 17)

    def test_unknown_missing_and_duplicate_fail(self):
        unknown = copy.deepcopy(BASE[0])
        unknown['name'] = 'unreviewed_rpc'
        for rows in [BASE+[unknown], BASE[:-1], BASE+[BASE[0]]]:
            with self.subTest(size=len(rows)), self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                guard['verify_functions'](rows)

    def test_authority_and_body_mutations_fail(self):
        for field, value in [('owner','anon'), ('acl','{=X/postgres}'),
                             ('execute_service_role',False), ('execute_anon',False),
                             ('config',None), ('body_md5','changed'), ('returns','void')]:
            rows = copy.deepcopy(BASE)
            self.assertNotEqual(rows[0][field], value)
            rows[0][field] = value
            with self.subTest(field=field), self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                guard['verify_functions'](rows)

    def test_malformed_inventory_fails(self):
        for value in [None, {}, [None], [{'name':'x'}]]:
            with self.subTest(value=value), self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                guard['verify_functions'](value)
